findings.title: fidelityNode helper not defined in diff
findings.message: The test calls fidelityNode, which is not defined in this diff. If it is not defined elsewhere in the package, the test does not compile. A nil result would also panic when Activate is called.
findings.suggestion: Ensure fidelityNode exists in the package's test files, and make it fail the test on a nil result.

findings.title: Brittle index-based mutation of QuantityField tree
findings.message: The code assumes the QuantityField View layout: Children[0] is the label, Children[1] is the controls container, and controls.Children[0] and [1] are the input and apply button. It also restructures the tree by index. Any change to QuantityField, such as an extra validation child, breaks this silently or panics. The `quantity.Children[2:]` slice also panics if there are fewer than 2 children.
findings.suggestion: Look nodes up by ID, or guard with length checks. Better, add layout options to QuantityField.

findings.title: color package may not be imported
findings.message: The new code uses color.NRGBA, but the diff does not show an import of image/color in view.go. If it is not already imported, the package fails to compile.
findings.suggestion: Confirm view.go imports "image/color"; add it if missing.
